remarks: Introducing an exquisite legal neoclassical Victorian 4-family house with 4 units located in a sought-after CD-3 zone. Property boasts 3,317 square feet. All units have separate utilities, showcasing elegant high ceilings and original interior and exterior accents. Noteworthy updates include renovated bathrooms in 3 of the units. Ample parking amplifies the convenience, while its prime location offers easy access to I-95, Merritt Parkway, SoNo Collection, Whole Foods, vibrant dining spots, trendy SoNo district, and beautiful beaches. Explore potential development opportunities, subject to individual due diligence with the town. 2 of the 4 units are currently rented and the tenants are month to month. House is sold, 'As Is.' Potential for townhouses, congregate housing, etc. and is zoned for up to 12 units.
